title: Hallmark Channel Christmas Promo
text: Christmas is almost here, and on the Hallmark Channel, we won't let you forget it with our Countdown to Christmas. From the people who bring you one-sentence greeting cards comes 21 full-length original Christmas movies coming this December. Lydia leaves her big city job to run her grandmother's Christmas tree farm and sparks fly when she crosses paths with her high school sweetheart. The only catch, he's young Santa. Is that your fiancé who lives in the city? Come on, come on, pick up. It's either me or Christmas, Lydia. He works too much, so it's okay if I cheat on him. Jessica Normal and Canadian handsome Chris Bairstick star in Yes, Santa. It's quantity over quality, people, and we are just blasting your ass with these. Michelle is a single mother and struggling baker whose Christmas wish goes horribly wrong. Now she's trapped in a snow globe, and the only person who can get her out before Christmas is her black co-worker with no backstory. Marcus, Marcus, I'm in here. Now what in the world? He says that same line four separate times. It's Kitchen Christmas Wish. Whether she's that girl from Party of Five or he's that guy from Desperate Housewives, you'll be asking, wait, how do I know that actor? All filmed during one month in Ottawa. Can you spot the sets we use multiple times? Hint, hint, the gazebo. Sarah. Sarah qualified for the Kingdom's Christmas Ice Skating Prize. But when she hits her head and gets amnesia, she forgets her ice skating routine and accidentally becomes a princess, starring a once famous, now very Christian actress, Meredith DeVoe Ellis and Chris Bairstick. We got him to be in two of these for no pay. You look familiar. Did I know you before I hit my head? I'm the prince, and you will be my princess. Another proposal. Rudolph, will you bring my sleigh around? What? It's Prince Santa. Hallmark, this is our Super Bowl. Christmas, Christmas, Santa Christmas.
